name: Forgotten Hall
desc: A long stone corridor lined with cracked burial niches.

name: Sealed Tomb
desc: A modest burial chamber with a weathered sarcophagus.

name: Ossuary
desc: Bones are stacked neatly against every wall.

name: Forgotten Chapel
desc: Broken pews face a crumbling altar.

name: Royal Vault
desc: Noble remains rest beneath faded banners.

name: Tomb of the Deathlord
desc: A colossal black sarcophagus dominates the room.

name: Winding Tunnel
desc: A narrow cave passage twists into darkness.

name: Underground Pool
desc: Clear water reflects the cave ceiling.

name: Fungal Grove
desc: Pale mushrooms blanket the ground.

name: Beast Nest
desc: Bones and scraps surround a massive den.

name: Crystal Chamber
desc: Glittering crystals emerge from every surface.

name: Bottomless Abyss
desc: A vast chasm swallows all light.

name: Barracks
desc: Rows of rotten bunks fill the room.

name: Old Armory
desc: Rusted weapon racks line the walls.

name: Supply Storehouse
desc: Crates and barrels clutter the floor.

name: Command Room
desc: Maps and military relics remain scattered about.

name: Trap Gauntlet
desc: The room itself seems designed to kill intruders.

name: Warlord's Throne
desc: A massive iron throne overlooks the chamber.

name: The Observatory Beyond Stars
desc: The ceiling is an endless night sky despite being underground. Constellations drift slowly, changing shape whenever observed.
quirk: Each turn may reveal the map, grant a permanent bonus, or spawn a cosmic entity.

name: The Last Clock
desc: A colossal clockwork mechanism fills an impossible chamber. Every gear turns silently.
quirk: Changes a global game rule for the remainder of the run.

name: The Empty Throne
desc: A lone throne sits in a black void stretching beyond sight. Something should be sitting there.
quirk: Player chooses to sit, destroy, or leave, permanently affecting the run.
